question: What is myscape?
answer: myscape is made up of two parts: a RuneLite plugin that syncs your in-game data to this website. This linking allows for the use of a suite of apps within myscape, such as a loot tracker with extended functionality, a way to view and search through all of your in-game possessions, a fully-functional mindmap creation app, and much more! All of these apps also offer the creation of shareable links to show others, whether or not they use myscape themselves.

question: Is myscape free?
answer: Yes. And it will be forever! I have no desire or plans to profit from others' use of myscape.

question: Do I need the RuneLite plugin to use the site?
answer: Yes. Without the plugin, the site has no data to populate its various apps with, so they must be used in-tandem.

question: How do I install the myscape plugin in RuneLite?
answer: Search for "myscape" in the Plugin Hub on RuneLite and install from there. For your account safety, never download myscape from anywhere else.

question: Do I need to create a website account before linking my character?
answer: Yes. Creating an account on myscape.io will then allow you to link your character(s) to RuneLite for actual use.

question: Why do I need to verify my email?
answer: Email verification helps make sure you never get locked out of your myscape account. If you forgot your password and didn't have access to the email you signed up with, there would be no way to get into your account — so we need to make sure you really have access to the email you sign up with!

question: Is myscape affiliated with Jagex?
answer: No. I created myscape as a personal project for myself, which it eventually grew into the RuneLite plugin and website it's made up of today — but Jagex isn't affiliated with its creation or upkeep at all.

question: Does the plugin break any Jagex rules or put my account at risk?
answer: No. The RuneLite plugin simply syncs your account data to the website, and there's no input that the plugin makes on the player's behalf.

question: How do I link my in-game character to my myscape account?
answer: After creating your account on myscape, you'll be prompted to generate a code to put into your RuneLite sidebar. Doing so will begin the process of linking your character's data to myscape. You'll need to open various storages for the site to populate with their items (bank, seed vault, etc.) for the first time upon linking. You'll also need to open your in-game collection log once to populate its data on myscape.

question: My linking code says it's expired or invalid. What do I do?
answer: Linking codes expire after 10 minutes, so you'll need to generate a new on on myscape.io by refreshing the page and clicking the "GENERATE CODE" button again.

question: How do I unlink my character?
answer: You can unlink your by clicking the "UNLINK" button in the RuneLite plugin's sidebar. You can also delete a character, or your entire myscape account, from the [Account page](https://myscape.io/account) on myscape.io, but doing so will permanently delete your character or account data on myscape permanently.

question: Can I link more than one character to the same account?
answer: Yes. You can do so by going to your [Account page](https://myscape.io/account) on the website and clicking the "+ ADD CHARACTER" button below your list of current character(s). Doing so will prompt you to generate a new code to put into your RuneLite plugin sidebar for the new character. If you're planning on using multiple characters on myscape, be sure to have each character on [its own RuneLite profile](https://github.com/runelite/runelite/wiki/General-Features#profiles).

question: How do I switch between my linked characters on the website?
answer: You can change which OSRS character's data you're viewing on myscape by going to your [Account page](https://myscape.io/account) and pressing the "SWITCH" button next to whichever character you'd like to have active. Your other characters' data will still sync in the background, but you'll need to switch back to them in order to view it on the website.

question: I changed my in-game character's name. Do I need to relink?
answer: No. Your character is linked through a hash that's specific to it, rather than by its name. Changing your name in-game won't break the character's connection to myscape.

question: Does myscape support ironman, group ironman, and other account types?
answer: Yes. Some features, such as the Purchase Goals app, won't be as useful for ironman accounts, but the rest of the site will work just fine for them. Ironman-specific apps may be added in the future.

question: How do I reset my password or change my email?
answer: You can reset your password or change your email by clicking the respective buttons at the bottom of your [Account page](https://myscape.io/account).

question: How often does the plugin sync my data to the site?
answer: The plugin automatically sends data when something in your game changes, usually within a couple of seconds. This includes xp drops, getting loot from an NPC, changing the contents of your bank/inventory, and much more. The main exception to this is the collection log; the data is still sent immediately when a new clog is received, but an inital opening of the collection log must happen for its contents to back-sync for the first time.

question: Why isn't my data showing up on the site yet?
answer: Most site data is automatically visibly updated on the site without a browser refresh, but for some things (such as constantly-updating xp drops), you might need to refresh for things to show up.

question: Would myscape show data I gained while not using the plugin, or on mobile?
answer: Yes and no. Levels and experience, for example, would update as soon as you log back in on a RuneLite client with the plugin running. Other data points, such as collection logs, would require re-visiting that page in-game to correctly repopulate. Some places on the site have a "refresh" button you can click to re-sync data that seems out of place, like boss kill counts from the official hiscores.

question: Why isn't my collection log complete on the site?
answer: If you gained collection log slots on mobile or while otherwise not using the plugin, you'll need to open the collection log in-game (while using the plugin on RuneLite) for the collection log to update on the site.

question: Why don't my storages on the site match what I have in game?
answer: Most storages, such as the bank, update automatically when performing routine actions such as withdrawing and depositing. Other storages require a bit more "finesse" in the background for the site to recognize data being changed. Re-opening whatever storage doesn't match will normally solve the issue within a few seconds.

question: Why are my kill counts on the site different from in game?
answer: The likely answer is that you gained kill counts while on mobile or without the plugin running; but regardless of why or how, using the "refresh" button on the collection log interface on myscape will grab new data from the hiscores and fix the problem.

question: Is my Character Overview page visible to others?
answer: Not by default. You can toggle the visibility of your Character Overview public profile page by clicking the "cog" icon next to the "CHARACTER OVERVIEW" title at the top of the page. This will also give you a shareable URL for giving to people you would like to share your public profile with. You can also reset your public URL (every 24 hours) if you'd like to invalidate previous links but still share your profile with certain people.

question: Why does my character model on my Character Overview look different from in game?
answer: You can update your character model to a "snapshot" of what your character model looks like in-game by clicking the "UPDATE MODEL" button on the plugin sidebar on RuneLite. It doesn't update automatically as you change your worn equipment.

question: Does the Loot Tracker include loot from before I installed the plugin?
answer: No. Only loot that you get while the plugin is installed, and your character is linked, will be included.

question: How do I hide an NPC or item I don't want to track?
answer: When hovering over an NPC or item on the Loot Tracker, you'll see an "eye" icon appear. Click that icon to hide that NPC (and its loot) or item.

question: How is the value of my loot calculated on the Loot Tracker?
answer: Live Grand Exchange prices are grabbed every few minutes to update the value of your loot. As such, prices will vary from time-to-time as prices update in the in-game economy.

question: How are item prices determined on the Storages Viewer?
answer: Live Grand Exchange prices are grabbed every few minutes to update the value of your items. As such, prices will vary from time-to-time as prices update in the in-game economy.

question: What does the "~" icon next to some of my item's prices mean?
answer: This icon is put next to the value of items that aren't technically tradeable, but are comprised of tradeable parts. For example, the Neitiznot faceguard is made up of a Basilisk jaw and Neitiznot helm, so both of these items' values are added together to get the price of the Neitiznot faceguard.

question: Why does an item I added to a Purchase Goals setup not show up on the Next Purchase section?
answer: Untradeable items (without untradeable components) don't show up as having a price, so they won't show up on the Next Purchase section. Food, potions, ammunition, and runes also do not show up on the Next Purchase section.

question: How do I share my Dashboard apps' content with others?
answer: Clicking the icon next to the page's title will give you an option to generate a shareable link with a snapshot of that page's current data.

question: How do I stop sharing something I shared earlier?
answer: You can do so by going to your [Account page](https://myscape.io/account), scrolling to the Shared Links section, and deleting specific links there. You can also delete all generated links by clicking the "DELETION" header text on that table.

question: How does the friends system on myscape work?
answer: You can add a friend by either 1) clicking the button next to their name on their public profile, or 2) entering their profile/friend code on your [Account page](https://myscape.io/account) and sending a request that way. You can view your friends list, and quickly visit their profiles, on the same page. Friends can view each other's profiles even when set to private. You can delete friends at any time, instantly revoking their access to view your private profile.

question: What is a public profile, and how do I turn it on or off?
answer: Your public profile is essentially a live, public version of your Character Overview page. You can toggle the visibility of your Character Overview public profile page by clicking the "cog" icon next to the "CHARACTER OVERVIEW" title at the top of the page. This will also give you a shareable URL for giving to people you would like to share your public profile with. You can also reset your public URL (every 24 hours) if you'd like to invalidate previous links but still share your profile with certain people.

question: What data does myscape collect, and who can see it?
answer: The only data that myscape collects and stores is your email, in case we ever need to send you an email to reset your password. Your password is encrypted and hidden to us. We cannot see or gain access to your OSRS or Jagex accounts. The only cookies that are collected are those which strictly allow the site to retain your preferences on your various apps' pages (such as a custom sort you create on the Purchase Goals, for example).

question: How do I delete my account and all my data?
answer: You can permanently delete your myscape account at the bottom of your [Account page](https://myscape.io/account). Doing so will remove all of your data in our systems.

question: Something looks wrong or broken. How do I report a bug?
answer: Visit our ["Report a Bug" channel](https://discord.com/channels/1550016350255054908/1550911126617722900) on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/myscape). Thanks for helping us make myscape better!

question: How do I request a new feature?
answer: Visit our ["Request a Feature" channel](https://discord.com/channels/1550016350255054908/1550917008147615964) on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/myscape). Thanks for helping us make myscape better!

question: Why can't I log in, and what should I do if I'm locked out?
answer: You can reset your myscape password [here](https://myscape.io/forgot-password).
